description: This file contains mapping functions for converting CSV lines and SQL rows to internal data structures, as well as functions for transforming and aggregating diff and commit data, and utility functions related to diff mapping in a version control analysis project.

methods.name: CSVLineToDiffRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line to a DiffRow object, validating length and parsing fields.

methods.name: CSVLineToCommitRow
methods.description: Converts a CSV line to a CommitRow object, validating length.

methods.name: batchToInts
methods.description: Converts a list of string representations of integers to a list of integers.

methods.name: diffRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms a diff row into a denormalized column representation for reporting.

methods.name: commitRowToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Transforms a commit row into a denormalized column representation for reporting.

methods.name: diffRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Prepares diff row data for persistence in database.

methods.name: commitRowToPersistCols
methods.description: Prepares commit row data for persistence in database.

methods.name: DiffRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts multiple diff rows into a batch of database insert rows with UUIDs.

methods.name: DiffRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts multiple diff rows into denormalized columns for reporting.

methods.name: CommitRowsToDenormalizedCols
methods.description: Converts multiple commit rows into denormalized columns for reporting.

methods.name: DiffRowsToAggregateChangesOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates diff rows over time, summing specific attributes.

methods.name: getSumOfAttribute
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a specific attribute across diff rows.

methods.name: CommitRowsToPersistCols
methods.description: Converts commit rows into database insert rows with UUIDs.

methods.name: SQLRowToDiffRow
methods.description: Converts a SQL row to an internal DiffRow structure.

methods.name: SQLRowToCommitRow
methods.description: Converts a SQL row to an internal CommitRow structure.

methods.name: PrependMappedDiffTarget
methods.description: Prepends diff target info to rows for mapping.

methods.name: AppendDiffTarget
methods.description: Appends diff target info to rows for reporting.

methods.name: SHA256HexDigest
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hex digest of a string.

methods.name: GetAuthorTechArea
methods.description: Determines the technical area of an author based on email hash.
